hypothesis: Lossless storage might reduce expert-weight traffic while preserving original FP8 bytes and scales; first determine actual device compression support and bounded real-weight compressibility.
scope: 27 MiB CPU byte analysis and context-free CUDA driver attribute query; no allocation or GPU work
controls: Readonly original checkpoint, no casts, no mutations, no cache/clock changes
stop: Unsupported generic compression prohibits a compressible-allocation GPU experiment; CPU entropy alone never authorizes a decoder/kernel or performance claim
